scope: Isolated stabilization worktree, local Node VM tests and source audit; no production load or browser/device rendering

confirmed_and_fixed.problem: Every route allocated a native/WASM NavMeshQuery without destroying it on success, early return or exception.
confirmed_and_fixed.change: Release the native query in finally after copying the existing route result; geometry, instructions and distance calculations are unchanged.
confirmed_and_fixed.measurement: 100 successful local routes: 100 created/0 destroyed before, 100 created/100 destroyed after. This is an allocation-lifecycle counter, not a browser memory measurement.

confirmed_and_fixed.component: mp_app.js ensureNavmesh(), wf_navmesh_bridge.js ensureRuntime(), wf_navmesh_route.js load()
confirmed_and_fixed.problem: Rejected initialization promises remained cached, preventing fresh user requests from recovering after a transient failure.
confirmed_and_fixed.change: Clear only the rejected promise so a later request can retry; retain pending-request sharing and ready-cache behavior.
confirmed_and_fixed.measurement: After one injected failure and a fresh route request, initialization attempts change from 1 to 2 and the second route succeeds. No Matterport iframe or SDK initialization is added.

existing_behavior_verified: Same-model background requests share pending initialization and reuse one iframe source assignment and one SDK connection.
Search/UI metadata updates, POI focus, camera rotation/zoom, route preview and Exit preserve the connected iframe and SDK.
Late model configuration and SDK responses cannot overwrite a newer model identity.
Internal Matterport loading/starting phases do not automatically restart the host viewer.
Ten pending route requests share one lazy initializer and only the newest route commits; clearing a route prevents a late restore.
Optional metadata/floor hydration preserves the same POI runtime and objects.
UNCC selects the lightweight mp_app.js runtime; its boot path does not fetch nav_graph.json, walkgrid.json or the ArcGIS runtime merely to display the model.
Anonymous prefetch cannot cross campus/API identity or bypass PIN/token/access-policy decisions.
Playback Exit cancels pending callbacks and future camera writes while retaining the viewer; pause/stall timing tests pass.

test_harness_repair.baseline_result: The two extracted goBuilding() tests fail with ReferenceError: window is not defined against immutable baseline commit 74f37ed.
test_harness_repair.change: Provide window: {} in those two VM contexts. No application navigation behavior was changed for this repair.

limitations: Android Chrome, iPhone Safari, real Matterport network transitions and device WebGL/GPU pressure were not exercised by these Node tests.
The native query leak is confirmed, but these tests cannot prove it caused a historical black loading screen or tab reload.
Cross-origin Matterport WebGL events remain subject to the existing diagnostics observability limits.
No UI, CSS, controls, route geometry, bundled WASM, POI data, database schema or published assets were changed by this audit.
